remarks: Step up to gracious living in our Two Bedroom, Two Full Bath, upper Level unit at this mid city high rise condo. Large Entry Area; Living Room with hardwood floors, great windows that bring in the light, sliders to a lovely Balcony; Kitchen with Refrigerator, New Dishwasher and Newer Stove, Microwave, New Faucet, Window above the sink+Large Pantry. Primary Bedroom suite with hardwood floors, Full Bath w/Stall Shower, New Vanity, New Light + window. Guest Bedroom Suite with hardwood floors, Full Bath with Shower over tub, New vanity. Heat/Hot Water & Central Air included in monthly rent. One, assigned, indoor garage. Additional parking space available at $75.00 a month. Laundry Facilities on "C" Level. State-of-the-Art Health & Fitness Center $15.00 a month. Elevated rear deck great for BBQ. Beautiful Community Room. 700 Credit or above required. Near restaurants, movies, library. Less than 10 minutes to I-95 and Stamford RR Station. You can have it all living at Hayes House. Please excuse current, but temporary clutter while tenants packing to move.
